provenance: Authored demonstration cases. Labels and walkthroughs are not search inputs or independent validation.

cases.title: Partial refunds and safe retries
cases.rule: Valid refunds settle once; retries have no additional effect; exhausted or conflicting requests reject without changing state.

cases.title: Preview, accept and preserve ownership
cases.rule: Preview is read-only; the recipient can accept; duplicate and unauthorized attempts preserve settled ownership.

cases.title: Retry charges the refund twice
cases.rule: Retrying a settled operation with the same amount must not add another refund.

cases.title: Split refunds exceed the captured payment
cases.rule: The total refunded amount must never exceed the captured payment, including across multiple requests.

cases.title: An operation key accepts a different amount
cases.rule: A settled operation key cannot be reused with a different amount; that request must reject without effects.

cases.title: A link preview transfers the ticket
cases.rule: Opening a preview must leave ownership and invitation status unchanged.

cases.title: Another account accepts the invitation
cases.rule: Only the named recipient may accept a ticket transfer; another account must be rejected.

cases.title: The component cannot compile
cases.rule: No business-rule verdict is available because the component cannot execute.
